title: osmunda regalis subsp. japonica
intro: Osmunda regalis subsp. japonica, commonly known as Japanese royal fern, is a species of flowering plant in the family Osmundaceae. This perennial fern is known for its potential health benefits, including its ability to lower blood pressure and reduce inflammation, making it a popular ingredient in traditional medicine. The therapeutic actions of Japanese royal fern include anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and immunomodulatory effects, which contribute to its use in treating various health conditions. The bioactive constituents responsible for these properties include polysaccharides, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which have been isolated and studied for their potential health benefits.
